archetype: ARCHETYPE 4: SWISS & HIGH-CONTRAST mixed with ARCHETYPE 2: THE PERFORMANCE PRO
app_type: SaaS Workspace & Complex Visual Editor Dashboard

headings.style: High impact, wide, architectural. Tightly tracked (tracking-tight).
headings.usage: Used for main workspace headings, editor panel titles, and large status displays.

body.usage: Standard UI text, properties descriptions, workspace data.

mono_labels.usage: Tree nodes, component layers, code snippets, system status (e.g., 'DRAFT', 'PUBLISHED', 'UNSAVED CHANGES').

visual_enhancers.shadows: Avoid soft drop shadows. Use hard structural elevation: 1px solid borders and subtle inner glows (e.g., shadow-[inset_0_1px_0_rgba(255,255,255,0.1)]).
visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid borders on all panels. Emphasize the Grid Layout Technical Rule (border-r, border-b) to create a blueprint-like interface.
visual_enhancers.surfaces: Solid flat colors. NO glassmorphism in the editor. Optical clarity is mandatory to prevent data refraction.
visual_enhancers.motion: Immediate, precise, functional. Micro-interactions for hover states on layers (bg-white/5). Active layer state uses 1px left-border accent.

layouts.workspace_overview: High-density Grid layout. Cardless design with sharp 1px borders. Use standard dashboard layout for audit reports and tenant settings.

visual_editor.structure: Three-pane technical layout. 100vh absolute height, overflow hidden. Top toolbar for global actions.
visual_editor.top_toolbar: Height 48px. Contains typographic 'VOLTORA' logo (left), Viewport toggles (center), Undo/Redo/Autosave status and Publish button (right).
visual_editor.left_sidebar: Pages & Component Tree (width: 260px). Dense list, mono typography for layers. Expandable/collapsible nodes.
visual_editor.center_canvas: Preview area. Generous padding around the iframe/preview container. Deep black background.
visual_editor.right_sidebar: Properties Panel (width: 300px). Accordion-style settings, compact inputs for design settings, visibility, and AI permissions.

components.buttons: Sharp corners (rounded-none or max rounded-sm). High contrast. Primary action (Publish) uses accent.primary background with text.inverse.
components.inputs: Shadcn defaults stripped of soft shadows. Flat background (bg-transparent or bg-surface), 1px border. Focus state: ring-1 ring-white.
components.tabs: Underline style or solid block style. No pill-shaped soft tabs. Use for switching between 'Design' and 'Settings' in the properties panel.
components.dropdowns: Solid dark background (#0A0A0A). 1px border. Z-index 50. NO transparent backgrounds.

motion.hover_states: Explicitly set hover text and background (e.g., hover:bg-white/10 hover:text-white).
motion.transitions: Fast and snappy. transition-colors duration-150. No transition-all.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text contrast meets APCA/WCAG standards. Use pure white against #0A0A0A for primary text.
accessibility.focus: 2px solid white offset ring on keyboard focus for all interactive elements.
accessibility.data_testid: MANDATORY on all buttons, links, inputs, and major containers (e.g., 'login-preview-button', 'footer-layer', 'publish-button', 'workspace-nav').

media.logo: Typographic 'VOLTORA' (font-family: Cabinet Grotesk, font-black, tracking-tighter, text-xl). DO NOT invent an image logo.

theme_preview_placeholder.description: Abstract placeholder for theme selection/preview thumbnails in workspace.

catalog_product_placeholder.description: Mock catalog item to display inside the preview canvas if needed.

steps: 1. Build a robust Top Header for the Editor with Typographic VOLTORA logo, Workspace breadcrumbs, Autosave indicator ('Draft'), and a 'Publish' action button.
2. Render Left Sidebar (Pages & Layers). Include explicit nodes for 'Pages -> Login' and 'Global -> Footer'.
3. Clicking the 'Login' node in the left tree MUST isolate the central canvas to show the customer authentication state preview.
4. Clicking the 'Footer' node MUST scroll the preview canvas to the bottom, highlight the footer, and expose global-edit impact warnings in the Right Sidebar.
5. Right Sidebar (Properties) MUST show functional design settings, undo/redo states, and draft version conflicts.

6. The 'Publish' button must trigger a workflow that displays 'Review affected pages', shows responsive device previews, and performs an explicit immutable publish action (simulated via Sonner toast).

instructions_to_main_agent: Prioritize building the visual editor screen as the richest primary product screen.
Implement Shadcn UI components but strip away the default 'Vercel' look to match the ARCHETYPE 4 technical dark mode design.
Include a 'Scoped Foundation Audit Report' dashboard view distinguishing pending legacy reviews.
Maintain high density in the editor sidebars and generous spacing in the central preview canvas.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts. Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all). Always add transitions for specific interactive elements.
You MUST NOT center align the app container. No .App { text-align: center; }.
Always use modern button styles (sharp or subtle roundness, not default soft pill shapes).
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons. Use lucide-react.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, explicit focus rings, and transitions.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute for QA automation.
Write pure JavaScript (.js/.jsx) with JSDoc if types are needed, do not use TypeScript (.ts/.tsx).
